fichas.title: Laying hens: floor housing
fichas.summary: Requirements for floor housing of laying hens, including facilities, stocking density, lighting, nests, perches, litter, and access to a cold scratching room. The page also illustrates floor housing with an open area for 1,600 birds.

fichas.title: Laying hens: small-group housing
